title: Integrated Anchored Stapling and Hierarchical Dynamics: MSICDA-Driven CREBBP Bromodomain Inhibition.
authors: Wang, Xinpei; Chen, Xu; Chen, Zhidong; Xu, Wanting; Lai, Ruizhi; Qiu, Xiaohui; Zeng, Zekai; Wang, Chenglin; Wang, Zhe; Wang, Junqing
journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
one_liner_zh: 该文聚焦CREBBP溴结构域与环肽抑制剂的结合设计，虽涉及蛋白-肽互作与MD模拟，但对象非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，方法可迁移性有限，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Despite recent success in the computational approaches of cyclic peptide design, current studies face challenges in modeling noncanonical amino acids and nonstandard cyclizations due to limited data. To address this challenge, we developed an integrated framework for the tailored design of stapled peptides (SPs) targeting the bromodomain of CREBBP (CREBBP-BrD). We introduce a powerful combination of anchored stapling and hierarchical molecular dynamics to design and optimize SPs by employing the MultiScale integrative conformational dynamics assessment (MSICDA) strategy, which involves an initial virtual screening of over 1.5 million SPs, followed by comprehensive simulations amounting to 154.54 mus across 5418 of instances. The MSICDA method provides a detailed and holistic stability view of peptide-protein interactions, systematically isolated optimized peptides and identified two leading candidates, DA#430 and DA#99409, characterized by their enhanced stability, optimized binding, and high affinity toward the CREBBP-BrD. In cell-free assays, DA#430 and DA#99409 exhibited 2- to 12-fold greater potency than inhibitor SGC-CBP30. Cell studies revealed higher peptide selectivity for cancerous versus normal cells over small molecules. DA#430 combined with (+)-JQ-1 showed promising synergistic effects. Our approach enables the identification of peptides with optimized binding, high affinity, and enhanced stability, leading to more precise and effective cyclic peptide design, thereby establishing MSICDA as a generalizable and transformative tool for uncovering novel targeted drug development in various therapeutic areas.
abstract_zh: 尽管近年来环肽设计的计算方法取得了成功，但当前研究在建模非经典氨基酸和非标准环化方面仍面临挑战，原因在于数据有限。为应对这一挑战，我们开发了一个集成框架，用于针对CREBBP溴结构域（CREBBP-BrD）的订书肽（SPs）进行定制化设计。我们引入了一种锚定订书与分层分子动力学相结合的强大方法，通过采用多尺度整合构象动力学评估（MSICDA）策略来设计和优化SPs，该策略包括对超过150万个SPs进行初步虚拟筛选，随后对5418个实例进行总计154.54微秒的综合模拟。MSICDA方法提供了肽-蛋白质相互作用的详细且全面的稳定性视图，系统性地分离出优化肽，并识别出两个领先候选物DA#430和DA#99409，其特征为增强的稳定性、优化的结合能力以及对CREBBP-BrD的高亲和力。在无细胞实验中，DA#430和DA#99409的效力比抑制剂SGC-CBP30高出2至12倍。细胞研究显示，与正常细胞相比，这些肽对癌细胞具有更高的选择性，优于小分子。DA#430与(+)-JQ-1联合使用显示出有前景的协同效应。我们的方法能够识别具有优化结合、高亲和力和增强稳定性的肽，从而实现更精确和有效的环肽设计，由此将MSICDA确立为一种可推广且变革性的工具，用于在各个治疗领域发现新型靶向药物开发。
